Name: Zuma's Revenge!
Description: PopCap's marble-shooting sequel. As a stone frog idol you spit colored balls to clear the chains snaking toward the skull before they reach it. Blast through 60 Adventure levels and the brutal Iron Frog gauntlet across tropical islands, hop between lily pads, thread balls through gaps, and topple six tiki-god bosses.
